einzeiler: Nobel laureate Daron Acemoglu on the crisis of liberal democracy and how to fix it.
kurzfassung: Nobel laureate and MIT professor Daron Acemoglu joins the program to discuss the crisis of liberal democracy, rising economic inequality, and the societal impacts of technology. He argues that liberalism is dying of self-inflicted wounds and advocates for working-class liberalism and pro-worker artificial intelligence. Additionally, Jessica Cogan, founder and CEO of HSP Brands, shares insights on marketing trends in the beverage and alcohol industry.
stichpunkte: Daron Acemoglu examines the crisis of liberal democracy and argues it is suffering from self-inflicted wounds.
Economic inequality has surged over the past four decades, with stagnant wages for half of the US population lacking a college degree.
Political polarization and a decline in institutional trust are widespread across advanced nations, exacerbated by segregated communities.
Social media algorithms amplify incendiary material and foster toxic communication, drawing people away from physical social networks.
Acemoglu advocates for working-class liberalism and developing pro-worker artificial intelligence rather than technologies that displace jobs.
Jessica Cogan discusses disruption in the beverage industry and the importance of in-store sampling for alcoholic brands.
